notes.title: #01 'M.E.M.O' Demo (α) Release Announcement
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Agents,[/h1]

We would like to extend our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who visited our booth at [b]Tokyo Game Show 2024[/b] and experienced our upcoming title, "M.E.M.O" Your enthusiastic participation and invaluable feedback have been an immense source of encouragement for our little team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107597/474389b9266ff2ef7777e57517481d27e740d48b.png[/img]

Throughout the event, we gathered a wide range of opinions and impressions, and our development team directly observed your gameplay experiences. Based on this, we are diligently working on refining and improving the game. 

To allow even more players to experience the allure of "M.E.M.O" [b]we are excited to announce that we will be releasing the demo(α) in mid-October.[/b]

We remain committed to meeting your expectations and are pouring our utmost efforts into development. We sincerely appreciate your continued support and encouragement.

[i][Iavg b nief daa !][/i]

Team Veister
